content: E-commerce relational schema (community knowledge, weak search results): canonical tables users(id,email,password_hash,name,created_at), products(id,sku,name,description,price,stock or separate stock table), orders(id,user_id,status,total,created_at), order_items(id,order_id,product_id,quantity,unit_price snapshot at purchase time). Key practices: snapshot unit_price in order_items, model stock with movements/ledger for consistency, separate order state machine (pending/paid/cancelled). Treated as hypothesis - validate with a proper schema reference during implementation.
